# Backlog — Phase 1 Gaps

> **Bridge style — link, don't duplicate.** This file indexes the **5 Phase 1 gaps** from the Phase 1 blueprint audit. Detail lives in the canonical sources linked per item; this table is the inventory only. Execution lives in the **MCP runtime** (`task-write` → `claim-manage` → `in_progress` → `completed`) — this doc mirrors the backlog, it does not execute it. For the testing-standardization execution plan see `../_tasks/testing-standardization.md` and its analysis [`../application/testing/benchmarks/testing-gap-analysis.md`](../application/testing/benchmarks/testing-gap-analysis.md).

## Source

- Audit scope: `.agents/documents/` against the blueprint Phase 1 contract (`application/` + `design/{architecture,domain,database,flows,decisions}/` + `tasks/{backlog,roadmap,sprints}/`).
- Prior plan: the only prior `tasks` reference was the sprint note in [`../application/presentation-brief.md`](../application/presentation-brief.md) §5–7 ("`tasks/` → `application/` migration", G3 gate). No prior `tasks/backlog.md` existed — `ls .agents/documents/tasks/` was correctly **missing** before this patch.
- Backlog context: `../_tasks/testing-standardization.md` (REFACTOR-TST-000..014, 13 tasks; TST-003..TST-011 shipped the 157-file suite, `d5a94d7`, §7.1 of [`../testing.md`](../testing.md); legacy fallback removed post-cutover).

## Rules

- **Max 5 items** — this file tracks exactly the Phase 1 gaps. New work beyond Phase 1 goes to MCP `task-write`, not to this table.
- **Status values:** `Open` → `In Progress` (MCP `in_progress`) → `Done` / `Done (parallel)` / `Done-as-S01`. Do not invent other statuses.
- **Priority:** P1 = blocks Phase 1 gate; P2 = follow-up within the same release train.
- **Sprint assignment is planning, not execution.** Sprint detail lives in [`sprints/manifest.md`](sprints/manifest.md) + [`sprints/sprint-01.md`](sprints/sprint-01.md).
- **Link, don't duplicate.** Each row's "Canonical" cell points to the source of truth — no prose is copied here.
